title: Each reader handles a closed PR that another open PR carries, so any carried PR can close at once
why: The owner wants every PR held by another open PR closed at once, reviewed or not (owner chat 21:27 and 21:29 CST Nov 9). Today the close-replaced-at-open lane closes only done PRs, because four readers lose a closed PR.
note: Starts after close-replaced-at-open. Readers that lose a closed carried PR: (1) `merge --reviewed` reads open PRs only; (2) skills/roadmap/build.py `unlaned`/`lane_live` flags a doing step whose only PR is closed and whose carrier sits on an integration branch (exit 1); (3) hooks/guard_merge.py, near line 1300, refuses an archive with the wrong text until the carrier merges; (4) settings.json lines 52 and 59 match no carried close. Done check: each reader handles a closed carried PR, then the close extends to any held PR. Source: lane close-replaced-at-open 22:15 CST, relayed by the coordinator 22:16 CST.
